title: Map Maker

serves.summary: The child makes a map seen from above of a pictured classroom or town block by putting each legend symbol where its thing is, and reads a finished map to put a hidden thing in the right place in the picture, which shows making and reading simple maps with symbols and a legend.

request.topic: Making and reading simple maps with symbols and a legend
request.objective: Turn a picture of a classroom or a town block into a map seen from above: put each legend symbol where its thing is in the picture, and read a finished map to find where a hidden thing is. (SS001-02-H, SS001-04-E, SS003-02-B, SS003-03-E)

problems.ask: Here is a picture of our classroom. Make a map of it with the symbols.
problems.goal: The plant symbol is at the back on the left, the bookshelf symbol at the back on the right and the trash can symbol at the front, left of the middle.

picture: plant at the back, far left
bookshelf at the back, far right
trash can at the front, left of the middle
